abstract.text: Set the prebuilt UI’s appearance and behavior once, globally, and override it where a screen needs something different.

inlineContent.text: The prebuilt UI reads its fonts, colors, delegates, and behavior from a
cascade of configuration values.
sits at the top.
Every other configuration is created from it, starts with its values, and
can override any of them:
The archive configuration above inherits the Georgia font and the blue
brand color, and so does the reader configuration inside it. Only the
reader’s background differs.

Each configuration covers one part of the prebuilt UI, and the reader’s
configuration nests inside the screens that open it:

code: GlobalConfiguration                 credentials, fonts, brand color, delegates, app configuration
├─ CarouselConfiguration            section and subsection ribbons, header
├─ ArchiveConfiguration             one archive: grid, labels, date picker
│  └─ ReaderConfiguration           the reader this archive opens

Wherever a configuration is optional and you pass
, the SDK creates
one from your global configuration. You only build the ones you change.
A configuration copies its values from the global configuration when you
create it. It doesn’t watch the global configuration afterward:

code: globalConfig.brandColor = .systemRed   // archiveConfig keeps the old brand color

inlineContent.text: So finish the global configuration first, then create the rest from it.
To change one screen, change its own configuration; to change everything,
change the global configuration before you create anything else.

abstract.text: Configuration for customizing the appearance and behavior of publication archive views.
Play videos and customize PDF hotspots in the prebuilt reader, which opens
the images, embeds, and links in edition pages itself.
Configuration settings specific to legacy replica reader interface.
A configuration object that provides global settings and delegates for
customizing the SDK’s behavior and appearance.
A standalone view controller for displaying publication archives.
A standalone view controller for displaying downloaded editions.
The app configuration from the PageSuite portal, which some reader
features read their settings from.
Read articles aloud in the prebuilt reader with the SDK’s text-to-speech
provider, or bring your own voice, text, and audio controls.
Optional delegate for enabling video and media playback. No playback functionality is provided by default.
Optional delegate used for handling paywall interactions within the SDK. Without it, paywalls are not displayed.
Build your own reader screen around the SDK’s edition reader: the screen
every custom-UI guide adds to.
Optional delegate for enabling commenting functionality within the reader.
Configuration object for customizing the prebuilt reader.
Match the prebuilt UI to your brand: fonts, colors, dark mode, icons, placeholders, dates, thumbnails, and Liquid Glass.
Let users share the page or article in view from the prebuilt reader’s
share button.
Loads the app configuration published in the PageSuite portal for a
shortcode.
Configuration for customizing the appearance and behavior of download archives.
Delegate responsible for providing audio features. Off (
) by default.
The base URL used when rendering HTML.
A standalone view controller for displaying bookmarked pages and articles.
A standalone view controller for searching edition content.
Embed digital newspaper and magazine editions in your iOS app. Use PageSuite’s prebuilt reader, or build your own interface on the same engine.
A view controller that presents an edition from PageSuite’s current
system, classic PDF or responsive, as a horizontally paged reader.
The backend that serves this archive’s editions when filtering by
A standalone view controller for displaying an edition on PageSuite’s
current system, classic PDF or responsive.
The application configuration authored in the PageSuite portal, decoded
from the remote configuration payload.
Configuration for the SDK’s built-in search interface.
Optional delegate that supplies advert banners and can replace the
rendering of advert pages.
Configure the prebuilt reader’s navigation bar, content browser, splash screen, and settings menu, and add rows of your own.
Maximum number of editions displayed in the archive.
The primary view controller provided by the SDK for presenting digital publication
content through an intuitive carousel interface.
Optional delegate to customize navigation actions triggered by the SDK.
Delegate that decides which pages can be shared and what the share sheet offers.
Configuration object for customizing the appearance, behavior, and sharing
strategies of the legacy replica reader.
Switch on comment buttons and counts in the prebuilt reader, and open
your commenting platform when users tap them.
Gate editions in the prebuilt UI behind your own subscription check and paywall screen.
Configuration object for customizing the prebuilt carousel interface.
Describes an entry in a kiosk grid of publications on PageSuite’s current
system.
Optional configuration for displaying a date picker to filter archived editions.
Configuration for customizing the appearance and behavior of bookmark archives.
A complete reader app you configure: edition archives, the reader, downloads, bookmarks, and search, styled to match your brand.
Show banner adverts in the prebuilt reader, and serve its advert pages
from your own ad stack.
Translate the prebuilt UI’s text, or replace any of its strings with your own.
Optional search configuration enabling in-reader search.
Delegate responsible for providing custom images and assets.
Provides a URL to a custom logo / masthead for a given published edition.
Used in the splash screen. Can be used by some templates.
